description: List the organization's connectors (GET /integrations), e.g. the Salesforce Work Order bridge: provider, instance URL, the project and list new work lands on (with names), whether it is on, the last poll time and the last error. Never shows secrets: the client id, the client secret, its storage name and the connector config are never returned. Read tier. Turning a connector on or off, retargeting it or adding one is done by an owner or admin in the TaScan portal, not by any tool.
name: tascan_list_connectors
